title: opencode Antigravity Auth Config - maene
description: PT: JSON Schema Draft-07 para ~/.config/opencode/antigravity.json do plugin maene. Implementa bypass de identificacao Gemini CLI com OAuth2 client_id 681255809395-oo8f…b135j, secret GOCSPX-4uHgMPm…lXFsxl, User-Agent GeminiCLI/0.57.0, X-Goog-Api-Client gl-node/22.19.0, Client-Metadata ideType=IDE_UNSPECIFIED,platform=PLATFORM_UNSPECIFIED,pluginType=GEMINI, project fallback rising-fact-p41fc. Pasta isolada resolvida por plataforma (MAENE_ISOLATED_DIR ou <opencode-base>/auth) protege constantes e config. Arquivo destino deve ter chmod 0o600 e escrita atomica. EN: JSON Schema Draft-07 for ~/.config/opencode/antigravity.json of maene plugin. Implements Gemini CLI identity bypass with OAuth2 client_id 681255809395-oo8f…b135j, secret GOCSPX-4uHgMPm…lXFsxl, User-Agent GeminiCLI/0.57.0, X-Goog-Api-Client gl-node/22.19.0, Client-Metadata ideType=IDE_UNSPECIFIED,platform=PLATFORM_UNSPECIFIED,pluginType=GEMINI, project fallback rising-fact-p41fc. Isolated hardened folder resolved per-OS (MAENE_ISOLATED_DIR or <opencode-base>/auth) protects constants and config. Target file must have chmod 0o600 and atomic write.

cli_first.title: CLI First Authentication
cli_first.description: PT: Se true, tenta autenticacao via `gemini` CLI local instalado (gemini-cli-tokens.json) antes de usar OAuth proprio do plugin. Util quando usuario ja esta logado no Gemini CLI. Reduz atrito de login e aproveita projectId ja resolvido. EN: If true, tries authentication via local `gemini` CLI (gemini-cli-tokens.json) before using plugin's own OAuth flow. Useful when user is already logged in Gemini CLI. Reduces login friction and reuses already resolved projectId.

toast_scope.title: Toast Notification Scope
toast_scope.description: PT: Escopo de exibicao de notificacoes toast no opencode. root_only = apenas no diretorio raiz / projeto principal, evita spam em subprojetos; all = mostra em todos os contextos. Legado: project/minimal/none sao mapeados para root_only/all. EN: Scope for displaying toast notifications in opencode. root_only = only in root / main project directory, avoids spam in subprojects; all = show in all contexts. Legacy: project/minimal/none map to root_only/all.

soft_quota_threshold_percent.title: Soft Quota Threshold Percent
soft_quota_threshold_percent.description: PT: Percentual de uso de quota (0-100) a partir do qual inicia aviso suave, fallback ou rotacao de conta. Ex: 90 significa que em 90% de uso comeca a alertar/trocar modelo. Usado para evitar 429 hard. EN: Quota usage percentage (0-100) from which soft warning, fallback or account rotation starts. E.g. 90 means at 90% usage it starts warning/switching model. Used to avoid hard 429.

quota_fallback.title: Quota Fallback Strategy
quota_fallback.description: PT: Estrategia de fallback quando quota atinge threshold. antigravity-first = prioriza modelos antigravity custom (gemini-3-pro/flash, claude-sonnet/opus) via cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com bypass; cli-first = prioriza tentativa via CLI local (menos controle de rotacao). Mapeia legado 'auto' -> antigravity-first e boolean true/false. EN: Fallback strategy when quota hits threshold. antigravity-first = prioritize antigravity custom models (gemini-3-pro/flash, claude-sonnet/opus) via cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com bypass; cli-first = prioritize local CLI attempt (less rotation control). Maps legacy 'auto' -> antigravity-first and boolean true/false.

quota_refresh_interval_minutes.title: Quota Refresh Interval (minutes)
quota_refresh_interval_minutes.description: PT: Intervalo em minutos para refresh do quota summary via retrieveUserQuotaSummary (v1internal). Controla cache de limites diarios por modelo. Range 1-1440 (1 dia). Default 15 min balanceia freshness vs rate-limit. EN: Interval in minutes to refresh quota summary via retrieveUserQuotaSummary (v1internal). Controls cache of daily limits per model. Range 1-1440 (1 day). Default 15 min balances freshness vs rate-limit.

soft_quota_cache_ttl_minutes.title: Soft Quota Cache TTL (minutes)
soft_quota_cache_ttl_minutes.description: PT: TTL do cache local de soft quota em minutos. Evita chamadas repetidas a cloudcode-pa para verificar quota. Armazenado em ~/.config/opencode/cache/antigravity/quota.json. Default 5 min. EN: TTL of local soft quota cache in minutes. Avoids repeated calls to cloudcode-pa to check quota. Stored at ~/.config/opencode/cache/antigravity/quota.json. Default 5 min.

pid_offset_enabled.title: PID Offset Anti-Detection
pid_offset_enabled.description: PT: Se true, aplica offset randomizado no PID e jitter no request para evitar deteccao de automacao/WAF. Usa pools de fingerprint: cliVersion 0.35.3, gl-node 22.19.0, platform linux/darwin/win32. Anti-ban delay 80-350ms. EN: If true, applies randomized PID offset and request jitter to avoid automation/WAF detection. Uses fingerprint pools: cliVersion 0.35.3, gl-node 22.19.0, platform linux/darwin/win32. Anti-ban delay 80-350ms.

google_search_enabled.title: Google Search Grounding Enabled
google_search_enabled.description: PT: Habilita ferramenta google_search com grounding (busca web) nos modelos que suportam. Desabilitado por default para reduzir latencia e consumo de quota. Requer modelo com suporte a tools. EN: Enables google_search tool with grounding (web search) on supporting models. Disabled by default to reduce latency and quota usage. Requires model with tool support.

debug.title: Debug Verbose Logging
debug.description: PT: Modo debug com logs verbosos seguros (sem expor secret GOCSPX-4uHgMPm…lXFsxl ou tokens). Loga safeDebugInfo com clientId, projectFallback rising-fact-p41fc, endpoints, UA GeminiCLI/0.35.3, X-Goog gl-node/22.19.0. EN: Debug mode with safe verbose logs (without exposing secret GOCSPX-4uHgMPm…lXFsxl or tokens). Logs safeDebugInfo with clientId, projectFallback rising-fact-p41fc, endpoints, UA GeminiCLI/0.35.3, X-Goog gl-node/22.19.0.

version_cache_ttl.title: Version Cache TTL (minutes)
version_cache_ttl.description: PT: TTL do cache de verificacao de versao/update do plugin em minutos. Default 60 min (1h), max 10080 (7 dias). Evita checagem excessiva de versao no startup. Armazenado em cache/antigravity. EN: TTL for plugin version/update check cache in minutes. Default 60 min (1h), max 10080 (7 days). Avoids excessive version checks on startup. Stored in cache/antigravity.

x-antigravity-bypass.note_secret: PT: Secret publico extraido do binario Gemini CLI, nao e segredo privado. EN: Public secret extracted from Gemini CLI binary, not private.
x-antigravity-bypass.folder_policy: nome curto minusculo blindada - short lowercase hardened
